notes: Premise: cmd_anchor (_tools/factdiff.py) calls write_state(state) for every selected source and re-anchors every fact citing a selected source (rows of other files too). Premise run 2026-10-12: inspect.getsource(cmd_anchor) holds both write_state(state) and the quote branch over all facts of the source; reproduces. Absorbs ST-2mi4asd4 (--quotes for one file overwrites other files' quote anchors; check anchor_quotes_keeps_other_files) and ST-6hrxxpvo (detect's log and snapshots written outside a refresh item's touches; detect has --out and --no-save; check detect_writes_within_touches). SP-etslk6yu close evidence: a research worker's anchor rewrote _fetch_state.csv wholesale (about 5,200 changed lines), restored by hand. Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 8 of 19, "Census and fact diff: anchor runs write only their own rows, judge confirms are sampled, cost figures are measured"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. Recurred in SP-u5q37ds3 (2026-10-13): ST-ra7u7hwd's factdiff.py anchor rewrote about 700 unrelated rows of kb/public/_anchors.csv and _fetch_state.csv; the worker restored both and kept only its new rows.
